title: Pipelines API v1 retired on 2026-12-04
summary: HubSpot retires the legacy CRM Pipelines API v1 on 2026-12-04; after that, calls to v1 endpoints stop working. The replacement is the Pipelines API 2026-09 version (GA 2026-09-09). The /crm-pipelines/v1 path comes from HubSpot's legacy v1 reference; the notice itself names no paths.
migrationNote: Migrate to the Pipelines API 2026-09 (or 2026-03 or newer) endpoints before 2026-12-04.
